reply: The launch generated $587,611.94 in sales, with Paper Towels leading at $175,001.62 and a 90.89% sell-through; Trash Bags also sold through strongly at 94.27%. Attention points include low sell-through for Storage Bins (24.25%) and Laundry Detergent (28.89%), while returns were highest for Insulated Tumblers at 12.59%. Actual operating cost was $138,343.78, above the $113,043.09 planned. This shows only the first rows.
